reason: I forget pills at home and travel a lot, so a sachet with the 2 capsules already counted that I can toss in my gym bag actually fits how I live. $24.99 for the first box is low enough to just try it, and the named lab report makes me less worried about it being junk.
objection: Still two capsules every day, and I will probably skip nights when I am traveling or wiped after the gym. I do not want to pay for a box that ends up half full in my bag.
